<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The head row of a hero band: skip link, brand, menu links (the current one carries aria-current), login and a
  call to action.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { NavLink } from "../blocks/nav-bar.types";

  export type HeroHeadProps = {
    brand?: string;
    brandHref?: string;
    links?: NavLink[];
    current?: string;
    login?: string;
    loginHref?: string;
    cta?: string;
    href?: string;
    skip?: string;
    navLabel?: string;
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import Link from "../compose/Link.svelte";
  import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.svelte";
  import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.svelte";
  import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    brand,
    brandHref,
    links,
    current = "",
    login,
    loginHref,
    cta,
    href,
    skip,
    navLabel,
    landmarkLabel,
  }: HeroHeadProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="header"
  class={cn("flex w-full flex-wrap items-center justify-between pr-4", defaults.hero.head)}
  data-testid="hero-head"
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  {#if skip}
    <LinkPlain
      href="#main-content"
      class={"sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:left-2 focus:top-2 focus:z-50 focus:rounded focus:bg-background " +
        "focus:px-4 focus:py-2 focus:text-sm focus:text-foreground focus:inset-ring focus:inset-ring-border"}
      data-testid="skip-link"
    >
      {skip}
    </LinkPlain>
  {/if}
  <MenuEntry
    href={brandHref}
    class={cn(defaults.text.small, "font-medium leading-6 text-background")}
    testid="brand"
  >
    {brand}
  </MenuEntry>
  {#if (links && ((links?.length ?? 0) > 0))}
    <NavBlock
      label={(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl("{0}, {1}", navLabel, landmarkLabel)) : navLabel)}
      testid="site-nav"
    >
      <Group gap="8" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
        {#each links as l (l.id)}
          {#if l.href}
            <Link
              href={urlOf(l.href)}
              variant="default"
              aria-current={((l.id === current) ? "page" : undefined)}
              class="text-xs font-medium leading-5 text-background"
              data-testid="nav-link"
            >
              {l.name}
            </Link>
          {:else}
            <Inline class="text-xs font-medium leading-5 text-background" data-testid="nav-link">
              {l.name}
            </Inline>
          {/if}
        {/each}
      </Group>
    </NavBlock>
  {/if}
  <Group gap="2" align="center">
    {#if login}
      <Button
        href={urlOf(loginHref)}
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        class="text-background hover:bg-background/10"
        data-testid="nav-login"
      >
        {login}
      </Button>
    {/if}
    {#if cta}
      <Button href={urlOf(href)} variant="secondary" size="sm" data-testid="header-cta">
        {cta}
      </Button>
    {/if}
  </Group>
</Block>
